caption: The drawing depicts a side view of a horse-drawn carriage with a fully enclosed passenger compartment that has four windows, two on each side. The body of the carriage is depicted in a dark brown to black color, with shading indicating dimension and form. The carriage has a roof extending over the front, covered wheels, and an external driver’s bench at the front with a vertically quilted seat back. There are four large wooden wheels, each with thin, evenly spaced spokes and black hubs, with the rear wheels being larger than the front wheels. The carriage is rendered on a plain, light-beige background with no additional objects or scenery. The structure of the undercarriage, including axles and frame elements, is visible in black and gray. The door features a small, horizontal handle, and the trim details are picked out in dark tones.
title: Cab or Cabriole
